results.title: AArete Names Healthcare Executive Pam Shipley as Chief Executive Officer
excerpts: _Global consulting firm's founder Loren Trimble to step down after 18 years of growth and leadership_ **CHICAGO, August 12, 2026** --( [BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com) )-- [AArete](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aarete.com%2F&esheet=54587379&newsitemid=20260810294659&lan=en-US&anchor=AArete&index=1&md5=2a5e7c9c62ae078b77191d5b13524728) , a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today the appointment of Pam Shipley as chief executive officer. A Fortune 25 healthcare executive with more than 30 years of experience, Shipley succeeds AArete founder Loren Trimble, who will transition from his role as CEO to board member. Shipley joins AArete from Centene Corporation, a leading managed care organization, in which she most recently served as chief strategy officer. She spent nearly 14 years at Centene over two tenures where she held multiple CEO roles in Georgia, Missouri and Mississippi and led digital transformation and market expansion across more than 15 markets. Over her three-decade career in healthcare, Shipley has built a reputation as an executive who combines deep operational expertise with technology-enabled innovation, including senior leadership roles at Kaiser Permanente and Sharecare spanning healthcare technology, provider operations and consulting-driven transformation. Recognized for her ability to align strategy, technology and operations to drive growth, Shipley brings to AArete a track record of helping organizations navigate complex transformations in highly regulated, technology-driven environments. "As a former client, I have worked closely with AArete throughout my career and witnessed firsthand the firm's ability to accelerate growth and drive results," Shipley said. "My work has always been personal to me. I've focused on making healthcare more affordable and effective for the people and communities served by health plans. AArete's talented team and proven solutions are uniquely positioned to help clients do exactly that. I'm honored to build on Loren's legacy and excited to continue delivering value for our clients." AArete drives profitability improvement, digital transformation and AI solutions for clients across several industries, with a particular focus on the healthcare payer segment. The firm advises U.S. health plans across lines of business, including Medicaid, Medicare, ACA Marketplace and commercial, helping clients manage the total cost of care and expand affordability without sacrificing quality or the member experience. In 2025, AArete secured a strategic investment from Parthenon Capital, a growth-oriented private equity firm with deep experience backing healthcare solutions and technology companies, further strengthening the firm's continued growth.
